destinations.name: US (formal entry, company import)
destinations.evidence: assumption: 0% general duty if classified under an ITA heading (e.g. HTS 8517.62); Chinese-origin surcharges (Section 301 and 2025 country tariffs) can add 25-45% or more and change often; a broker confirms the HTS code; verify on the USITC HTS and CBP
destinations.note: Products with a lithium-metal cell installed ship as UN3091, IATA PI 970 Section II; the cell vendor's UN 38.3 test summary travels with the shipment

destinations.name: EU (formal import)
destinations.evidence: estimate: VAT 17-27% on CIF + duty; duty 0% under an ITA heading; VAT is recoverable for a VAT-registered importer (landed-cost.md)

destinations.name: UK (formal import)
destinations.evidence: estimate: VAT 20% + duty by commodity code, 0% expected under an ITA heading; verify on gov.uk

destinations.name: Brazil (company import, regime comum, after Anatel homologation)
destinations.evidence: estimate: II + IPI + PIS/COFINS + ICMS inside the base (landed-cost.md); a customs broker confirms the NCM; CBS/IBS reform from 2027
